law_name: Law No. 9/2022 of 29 June 2022 on Copyright and Related Rights (repeals Law No. 4/2001)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years; 50 years for computer programs and phonograms/videograms
registration_required: No (registration is not required for protection but creates a presumption of ownership)
enforcement_body: National Institute of Cultural and Creative Industries (INICC, IP) - optional registration of works under Law 9/2022
notes: In force 90 days after publication on 29 June 2022 (about 26 Sep 2022). Replaced Law 4/2001; term for the 2001 law was also life + 70.
